correctness.rationale: The one-ball paired avoidance probability follows exactly from the retain/independent-refresh transition kernel. Two-dimensional inclusion-exclusion yields all finite mixed falling-factorial moments. Their asymptotics, including tau=0 and tau=infinity, equal those of three independent Poisson variables. Convergence on the countable state space strengthens to total variation. The exact covariance follows by separating equal and distinct box indices. The companion checker verifies 168 exact rational identities; it is corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Uniform coupon coverage is at a nondegenerate threshold. The resampling probability 1/log n is the natural scale for loss or restoration of the O(1) remaining empty boxes across n log n observations. The law determines the entire common/unique missing-box structure, strict interpolation of conditional coverage reliability, and the complete noise stability phase transition. Marginal coupon Poisson limits alone cannot recover the result; the parameter and observable are motivated by robustness of coverage under data perturbations.
